purpose: test whether source-aware Native, page and source-bound region routing reduces verified information loss without always-all cost
truth_opening: only after acquisition, deduplication, runtime binding, route predictions and the pre-open gate are immutable

source_selection.authority: official public publisher or standards body only
source_selection.transport: HTTPS original bytes; landing-page text is metadata, never ground truth
source_selection.canonical_url: exact HTTPS URL after redirects; lowercase ASCII host; no userinfo, fragment or explicit port; path and query preserved byte-for-byte
source_selection.order: manifest grouped by required_classes order, then SHA256(canonical source URL) ascending within each class
source_selection.replacement: none after acquisition begins; an unavailable or ineligible source remains unresolved
source_selection.near_duplicate_rule: each unit must have a unique source hash, canonical URL and source-family identifier; exclude sibling pages or files from one source package and every family seen in development
source_selection.rights_rule: retain only sources with an HTTPS rights-evidence URL and recorded terms that permit local research evaluation; do not redistribute original bytes
source_selection.target_rule: record one truth-free source-native or bbox1000 locator before inference; no locator may be added or changed after seeing model behavior

router_policy.source_authority: may select a native or authority witness only when the source contract supplies it
router_policy.visual_recovery: must be bound to an existing page or region locator; no invented bbox
router_policy.agreement: corroboration only; model agreement is never independent truth
router_policy.stop: accept only verified declared scope; otherwise unresolved

required_digests: each model runtime, bundle and inference config
preopen_binding.manifest_schema: strict allowlist; unexpected fields are rejected
preopen_binding.prediction_schema: one route plan per selected unit; exact source and policy binding; truth, labels, expected answers and evaluator outputs forbidden

metrics.denominator: every selected target unit in every arm
metrics.statistics: paired source-cluster bootstrap with 5000 replicates; report all catastrophic failures
metrics.promotion_rule: no model or router promotion unless the exact frozen primary and guardrail rules pass on the unopened holdout

execution_budget.cleanup: terminate every created pod and independently verify zero live pods
